scope: Bridgetown-Greenbushes councillor vacancy; targeted official WAEC cross-check.

findings.finding: The 9 October notice describes Simon Robinson's resignation as effective immediately. The later 5 November agenda says it took effect on 6 October and uses that date for its statutory calculations. The official records differ on timing. The agenda says an extraordinary election is required and records WA Electoral Commissioner approval for 18 March 2027, which Council was asked to fix. An adopted resolution, final date, voting method and timetable were not verified.
findings.access: Original notice and special meeting agenda, item 11.1, reviewed. The official meeting page linked the agenda only.

limits: The WAEC December notice confirms the existing 3 December postal elections. That notice does not determine this vacancy.
This scoped review does not recertify any other WA councillors, rosters or nominations.
